Verify it yourself

Run this with stock Sigstore tooling — no Attestrum install required. cosign contacts the Sigstore network (TUF, Rekor) to check the certificate chain and transparency-log inclusion, then prints the result:

cosign verify-blob-attestation \
  --new-bundle-format \
  --type https://attestrum.com/attestation/training-corpus/v0.3 \
  --bundle attestrum/bundle.sigstore.json \
  --certificate-identity https://github.com/my-org/my-dataset/.github/workflows/build.yml@refs/heads/main \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com \
  attestrum/manifest.parquet

The Attestrum CLI's attestrum verify runs the same Sigstore verification from the command line. See github.com/Attestrum/Attestrum.
